checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact (48 distinct tips) and distinct_elution_wells passed; code uses a p1000 with a new tip per tube and column-matched elution wells.
Beads 40, isopropanol 250, then sample 250 in order with p1000.mix(5,...); 5 min delay, magnet engaged 4 min, then 540 uL supernatant removed to waste with magnet on (checks all passed).

add_ethanol/remove_supernatant run twice with 500 uL each with magnet engaged; a 4 min delay follows, then magdeck.disengage() before elution (checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed).
The recovery step aspirates ELUTION_VOL (100 uL) rather than about 80 uL (m300.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL, src.bottom(0.5))), so it risks pulling beads and does not match the ~80 uL specification.
Step order and reagents follow the OT-2in-house protocol, with accurate comments (70% ethanol, 540 uL removal) and only minor additions such as bead resuspension mixing.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 run-log checks and correctly implements sample handling, binding, washes and drying, and it follows the paper's steps. It fails elution_recovery because it recovers 100 uL instead of about 80 uL of eluate, which risks carrying over beads.
